A.claim: Unified: if 3 | gcd(x,y,z) or 4 | gcd(x,y,z), then A^x + B^y = C^z has no positive solutions. Packages the 3|x,3|y,3|z family (FLT3) and the 4|x,4|y,z even family (not_fermat_42).

B.claim: Beal is equivalent to: 2 is an obligatory exponent for every non-trivial primitive solution in the hyperbolic regime. Of the ten coprime Fermat-Catalan solutions listed in the external survey, the nine whose identities verify all have 2 among their exponents.
